supplies.analysis: The €900,000 school furniture programme must be divided into lots, each below the EU supplies threshold of €221,000. I propose 5 lots to ensure competitiveness and sustainability. Each lot will have a value below the threshold and a life-cycle award criterion. The proposed lots are: Lot 1 - desks (€180,000), Lot 2 - chairs (€160,000), Lot 3 - tables (€140,000), Lot 4 - storage units (€120,000), and Lot 5 - miscellaneous furniture (€200,000).

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: I strongly recommend allocating 60% of the annual procurement budget to supplies, with the €900,000 school furniture programme divided into 5 lots: Lot 1 - desks (€180,000), Lot 2 - chairs (€160,000), Lot 3 - tables (€140,000), Lot 4 - storage units (€120,000), and Lot 5 - miscellaneous furniture (€200,000), using a life-cycle award criterion with price 40% and quality 60% weights. This will ensure competitiveness and sustainability while adhering to the EU supplies threshold of €221,000. The award criterion is based on the best price-quality ratio, prioritizing both cost-effectiveness and environmental considerations.
